frontend_cases.name: ja_smoothed_parameter
frontend_cases.note: Self-contained Jiles-Atherton-shaped sentinel for a recursively smoothed parameter reused through four substeps and stereo composition. See porting/ja-smoothed-parameter-propagation-analysis-and-optimization-plan-2026-08-08-en.md. Lowered 2026-10-18 to the largest value observed in CI runs 38148527657, 38317887585 and 38374565145 (the green runs before the 2026-10 front-end speedups, hence an upper bound). Previous baseline: 510.000 units.
